# Dr. Chintan Gujarathi — Plastic, Cosmetic & Reconstructive Surgeon in Pune

> Dr. Chintan Gujarathi is a Senior Consultant Plastic, Cosmetic, Reconstructive, and Microvascular Surgeon based in Pune, Maharashtra, India. He holds dual super-specialty board certifications: MCh (Plastic Surgery) and DrNB (Plastic Surgery), with surgical observerships at Tata Memorial Hospital (Mumbai) and Ganga Hospital (Coimbatore). He has 15+ years of surgical experience and has completed 500+ microvascular and reconstructive surgeries. He operates personally at Ruby Hall Clinic (Sassoon Road) and Manipal Hospital (Kharadi).

## Core Practice & Hospital Locations

* **Ruby Hall Clinic (Central Pune):** 102, 1st Floor, Cancer Building, 40 Sassoon Road, Pune, Maharashtra 411001. Consultation Timings: Mon–Sat 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM.
* **Manipal Hospital (Eastern Pune / Kharadi IT Hub):** 22/2A, Mundhwa-Kharadi Road, near Nyati Empire, Kharadi, Pune, Maharashtra 411014. Consultation Timings: Mon–Sat 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM.
* **Direct Appointment / Consultation Hotline:** +91 79774 29688 (079774 29688)
* **Official Website:** https://drchintangujarathi.com

## Pillar 1: Facial Aesthetics & Rejuvenation

* [Facelift, Neck Lift & Brow Lift](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/facelift-surgery-in-pune): Deep-plane SMAS rhytidectomy, corset platysmaplasty, and endoscopic brow elevation with concealed incisions and 10–15 year longevity.
* [Rhinoplasty & Septorhinoplasty](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/rhinoplasty-in-pune): Open and closed structural preservation rhinoplasty, dorsal hump reduction, tip refinement, and deviated septum correction.
* [Blepharoplasty (Eyelid Surgery)](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/blepharoplasty-eyelid-surgery-in-pune): Upper and lower eyelid rejuvenation, herniated periorbital fat repositioning, and skin redundancy excision.
* [Buccal Fat Removal & Dimple Creation](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/buccal-fat-dimple-creation-in-pune): Bichat fat pad excision for cheek contouring, intraoral dimpleplasty, and lingual frenuloplasty tongue-tie release.
* [Torn Earlobe Repair & Otoplasty](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/torn-earlobe-repair-in-pune): Lobuloplasty for split and stretched earlobes, micro-flap suturing, and prominent ear setback otoplasty.
* [Facial Bone Fracture Treatment](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/facial-bone-fracture-treatment-in-pune): Open reduction and internal fixation (ORIF) with titanium mini-plates for mandible, zygoma, orbit, and maxilla fractures.
* [Cosmetic Suturing of Facial Cuts](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/facial-cut-scarless-suturing-in-pune): Emergency layered microsurgical closure of traumatic facial lacerations with 6-0/7-0 monofilament sutures.
* [Ageing Face Treatments (Botox & Fillers)](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/anti-aging-botox-fillers-in-pune): Comprehensive non-surgical facial rejuvenation combining neurotoxins and hyaluronic acid dermal fillers.
* [Botox Treatment](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/botox-treatment-in-pune): US-FDA approved Botulinum Toxin injections for forehead lines, crow's feet, frown lines, and masseter reduction.
* [Dermal Fillers Treatment](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/dermal-fillers-treatment-in-pune): Hyaluronic acid volumization for nasolabial folds, tear troughs, cheeks, jawline, and lip augmentation.

## Pillar 2: Body Contouring & Breast Aesthetics

* [Gynecomastia Surgery (Male Chest Reduction)](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/gynecomastia-surgery-in-pune): Dual-plane subareolar gland excision combined with VASER ultrasonic liposuction for a flat, masculine chest.
* [Liposuction 360° & Body Sculpting](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/liposuction-surgery-in-pune): VASER high-definition ultrasonic lipolysis for abdomen, love handles, flanks, back, and thighs.
* [Abdominoplasty (Tummy Tuck)](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/tummy-tuck-abdominoplasty-in-pune): Full and mini tummy tuck with rectus abdominis muscle diastasis plication and lower apron excision.
* [Breast Surgery (Implants, Lift & Reduction)](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/breast-surgery-implants-lift-in-pune): Cohesive silicone gel breast augmentation, mastopexy lift, and inferior pedicle reduction mammoplasty.
* [Arm Lift & Thigh Lift](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/arm-lift-thigh-lift-surgery-in-pune): Brachioplasty and medial thighplasty for sagging skin correction following massive weight loss.
* [Female Genital Rejuvenation](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/female-genital-rejuvenation-in-pune): Labia minora reduction (labiaplasty), clitoral hood contouring, and reconstructive hymenoplasty.
* [Mommy Makeover Surgery](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/mommy-makeover-surgery-in-pune): Single-session combination of abdominoplasty, breast lift/augmentation, and 360° liposuction for maternal restoration.

## Pillar 3: Reconstructive Surgery & Microsurgery

* [Cancer Reconstructive Surgery](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/cancer-reconstructive-surgery-in-pune): Microvascular free tissue transfer (ALT flap, Free Fibula flap) for head, neck, and oral cancer defects.
* [Burn Treatment & Scar Surgery](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/burn-treatment-scar-surgery-in-pune): Acute burn care, tangential excision, split-thickness skin grafting, and contracture release with Z-plasties.
* [Trauma Plastic Surgery](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/trauma-plastic-surgery-in-pune): Emergency limb salvage, open fracture soft-tissue coverage, local muscle flaps, and propeller perforator flaps.
* [Diabetic Foot & Chronic Wound Care](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/diabetic-foot-wound-care-in-pune): Limb salvage surgery, negative pressure wound therapy (VAC), hydro-debridement, and bedsore rotational flaps.
* [AV Fistula Surgery](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/av-fistula-surgery-in-pune): Radiocephalic and brachiocephalic arteriovenous fistula creation for hemodialysis vascular access.
* [Microvascular Free Flap Surgery](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/microvascular-free-flap-surgery-in-pune): Advanced super-microsurgery and free tissue transfer for complex trauma and oncological defects.

## Pillar 4: Hand, Peripheral Nerve & Specialized Excision

* [Hand Surgery & Carpal Tunnel Release](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/hand-surgery-carpal-tunnel-in-pune): Open and endoscopic flexor retinaculum release, flexor/extensor tendon repairs under WALANT local anesthesia.
* [Nail Bed & Fingertip Repair](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/nail-bed-fingertip-repair-in-pune): Micro-suturing of nail bed lacerations, germinal matrix repair, and Atasoy/Kutler V-Y advancement flaps.
* [Peripheral Nerve Surgery](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/peripheral-nerve-surgery-in-pune): Microsurgical epineural nerve repair, nerve grafting, and sural/muscle biopsies for neuropathies.
* [Cyst, Lipoma & Ganglion Excision](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/cyst-lipoma-ganglion-excision-in-pune): Complete capsule excision for sebaceous cysts, subcutaneous lipomas, and wrist ganglion cysts under local anesthesia.
* [Pediatric Plastic Surgery & Cleft Lip](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/pediatric-plastic-surgery-cleft-lip-in-pune): Millard rotation-advancement cleft lip repair, two-flap palatoplasty, and pediatric congenital anomalies.
* [Scar Revision & Keloid Treatment](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/scar-revision-keloid-treatment-in-pune): W-plasty, geometric broken line excision, intralesional triamcinolone injections, and silicone compression therapy.
* [PRP & GFC Skin Treatment](https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/prp-gfc-skin-treatment-in-pune): Autologous platelet-rich plasma and growth factor concentrate therapy for skin rejuvenation and scar healing.

## Key Patient Information & FAQs

* **Consultation Fees & Quotes:** Transparent pricing provided during in-person evaluation at Ruby Hall Clinic or Manipal Hospital Kharadi.
* **Insurance & Cashless Mediclaim:** Accepted for reconstructive surgeries, trauma, burns, diabetic foot salvage, cancer reconstruction, and symptomatic functional procedures at both hospital TPA desks.
* **Emergency Availability:** Immediate trauma, facial cuts, acute burns, and crushed hands attended to at Ruby Hall Clinic and Manipal Hospital emergency departments.
